summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the issuance of Financial Bills with subordination clauses totaling R$1.3866 billion (approx. $250M) to private investors, maturing in ten years with a repurchase option starting in 2031. Proceeds will compose Level II of Reference Equity under BCB Resolution No. 122. This is a routine capital management activity, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. No deal terms or event-driven risk-arb angle applies.
